We are all set to go. This is a massively high-scoring ground and will we see 300 breached tonight? We saw a beaming smile from Shreyas at the toss. Is it advantage India? Or can West Indies do what India did to them in the last game? A packed crowd in at the RGIS. India in a huddle at the moment. They break out with Shreyas and Axar sporting big smiles. Ishan too has one. Out walk the players. A new opening combo for West Indies with Shai Hope and Jewel Andrew out there. One Barbadian and the other Jamaican. The bell is rung and we are all set....

Mayank Yadav will start off for India. He was pacy and nippy in the last game. Let's see how he goes tonight. Lovely night in Hyderabad and the packed stadium will be hoping for a great game. The countdown is done. Here we go...
Shai Hope and Jewel Andrew are at the crease. Shai Hope is on strike. Mayank Yadav will open the attack
